model_system: CeRu3Si2 kagome superconductor with competing charge-ordered phases (parent P6/mmm; CO Pmma q=1/2; CO-II Imma q=1/3)

key_params.crossover_point: CO and CO-II nearly degenerate at U = 6 eV
key_params.Ce_4f_treatment: must be included as valence states; treating as core suppresses q=1/3 and fails to stabilize q=1/2 as ground state
key_params.phonon_instability: multiple imaginary modes in qz = 1/2 plane
key_params.reported_lattice_sensitivity: <0.4% change in lattice parameters from U=0 to 9 eV

headline_claim: DFT+U reproduces the experimentally dominant q=1/2 charge order in CeRu3Si2 only for Ce 4f correlation strength U > 6 eV, with the weaker q=1/3 order remaining nearly degenerate.
replication_difficulty: medium - requires correlated first-principles total-energy comparisons of multiple distorted structures and Ce 4f treatment sensitivity.
